consequences: No plaintext history index or model call is introduced. Search scans owned conversations in bounded batches and exposes continuation; no snapshot-isolation promise is made while new commits reorder mutable offset pages. Broader data-volume and provider compatibility certification remain separate.
context: History had real body search and pagination but preview lacked a bounded reading viewport, earlier-message failures could fail a newer send, ABA requests could be accepted, and recency was sorted only inside creation-time pages.
decision: Reuse existing Host/Gateway contracts. Preserve actual visible-message anchors in preview and conversation views, separate history errors from turn state, gate pagination responses by request epoch/scope and monotonic cursor, and provide search retry. Sort scoped binding metadata by actual journal activity before pagination; decrypt only first/last text for unfiltered summaries and keep full search on canonical encrypted history. Probe older rows for exact terminal cursors.
title: History reading continuity and encrypted metadata summaries v1
